login.title: Connect to Pi Router
login.intro: Enter the management bearer configured in PI_ROUTER_MANAGEMENT_KEY. It is used only against this loopback origin.
login.label: Management bearer
login.rememberHelp: Optional. Stored with reversible obfuscation, not encryption.
login.loopbackBody: Loopback is the default. Raw config can explicitly allow a remote listener.
login.storageBody: The bearer stays in memory unless you choose Remember. System can clear the retained envelope.
login.metadataBody: The management key can read raw config and explicitly import or export credential files.
login.notice: Authentication begins only after this form is submitted. Inference clients use separately managed proxy API keys.

errors.network: Pi Router is not reachable on this loopback origin.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: A bounded view of the local gateway, active account, operational activity, and recovery posture.
dashboard.restartMessage: Version {{version}} is pending activation; this console cannot restart the process.
dashboard.connectionNotice: Management authentication is separate from the {{count}} proxy API keys accepted by inference clients.
dashboard.proxyKeysDetail: Managed independently from the management key
dashboard.runtimePostureBody: Current process identity. Values are bounded and contain no raw state paths.
dashboard.activitySummaryBody: Recent counts from the sanitized process-memory event buffer.
dashboard.keySectionBody: These keys authenticate /v1 clients only. Values are generated server-side and disclosed once on create or replace.
dashboard.copyNowBody: It disappears when you dismiss it or reload the page.
dashboard.label: Label
dashboard.updateRecoveryBody: Release discovery is explicit. Install and rollback keep the existing verified recovery boundary.
dashboard.binaryInstallAvailable: Native Termux binary; verified install is available.
dashboard.sourceInstallDisabled: Source mode; release checks are available but install is disabled.
dashboard.noReleaseCheck: No release check has run in this page session.
dashboard.installBody: Install v{{version}} after fresh checksum and Android AArch64 validation? The running process will still require restart.
dashboard.rollbackBody: Replace the installed binary with its retained verified predecessor? The running process will still require restart.
dashboard.replaceKeyBody: Replace {{label}}? Its current value stops working immediately and the new value is shown once.
dashboard.removeKeyBody: Remove {{label}}? Clients using it will lose inference access.
dashboard.keyCreated: Proxy API key created. Copy its value now; it will not be shown again.
dashboard.keyReplaced: Proxy API key replaced. Existing clients must use the new value.
dashboard.keyCopyFailed: Could not copy the proxy API key.
dashboard.versionInstalled: Version {{version}} installed. Restart Pi Router to activate it.
dashboard.binaryRestored: Previous verified binary restored. Restart Pi Router to activate it.

providers.title: AI Providers
providers.description: Registered provider capabilities, authentication posture, and model availability from the pinned Pi runtime.
providers.customDescription: Add an OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions, or Anthropic Messages provider.
providers.customNotice: Base URL, API key, headers, proxy, prefix, alias, and exclusions are written to raw config after confirmation.
providers.testPassed: The provider returned a successful protocol response.
providers.testFailed: The provider protocol test returned HTTP {{status}}.
providers.inventoryBody: Model totals include the known catalog; available totals require configured authentication.
providers.filterPlaceholder: Filter by provider name or id
providers.noneBody: Built-in or custom providers appear after the runtime registers them.
providers.noMatchBody: Clear or broaden the filter to see the provider inventory.
providers.applyBody: Write the {{id}} provider, including any entered secrets, to raw config?
providers.invalidId: Provider id may contain only letters, numbers, dot, underscore, or hyphen.
providers.invalidHeaders: Headers must be a JSON object whose values are strings.
providers.configUnavailable: Provider configuration is not currently editable.
providers.duplicate: That provider id already exists. Edit it in Config Panel.
providers.validationFailed: Provider configuration did not pass validation.

authFiles.title: Auth Files
authFiles.description: Credential metadata plus explicit raw auth-file import and export.
authFiles.boundaryBody: The management key may download raw credentials. Imported files always receive a new isolated account.
authFiles.transferUnavailable: This backend does not advertise credential import/export.
authFiles.exportWarning: Warning: exported credential files contain plaintext API keys or OAuth tokens. Store and share them as secrets.
authFiles.imported: Imported {{count}} credential file(s) into isolated accounts.
authFiles.storedDescription: Search and page isolated credential records without exposing their values.
authFiles.searchPlaceholder: Search label, account, provider, or type
authFiles.emptyBody: Authenticate a provider to make its models available to the local gateway.
authFiles.noMatchBody: Clear the search or choose a broader filter.
authFiles.valueHidden: Value hidden by the management boundary
authFiles.modelsUnavailable: Model inventory is not exposed by this backend.
authFiles.policyUnavailable: Per-credential aliases and exclusions require a future typed backend capability.

oauth.title: OAuth Login
oauth.description: Add a provider credential to a new isolated Pi account or explicitly update an existing one.
oauth.singleUseBody: Prompt values stay in current page memory, are submitted once, and are never echoed by the Management API or event log.
oauth.startBody: Choose one provider and one runtime-supported authentication method.
oauth.noProvidersBody: Add a custom provider configuration or inspect runtime startup.
oauth.accountHelp: Selecting an existing account replaces only that account/provider credential; inference account selection does not change.
oauth.labelHelp: If omitted, Pi Router derives a label from provider identity and adds a unique suffix when necessary.
oauth.oauthHelp: Follow the provider-owned browser or device flow.
oauth.apiKeyHelp: Submit the provider key through one secret prompt.
oauth.sessionActivityBody: Safe progress and prompt metadata from the current in-memory session.
oauth.noSessionBody: Select a provider and start a session. No background login begins on page load.
oauth.noProgress: The session emitted no public progress events.
oauth.savedBody: Saved as {{label}}; provider inventory refreshes without exposing the credential.

quota.title: Quota Management
quota.description: Real provider-backed limits are read separately for every OAuth credential and provider.
quota.notice: Quota reads are explicit, credential-scoped, and adapter-specific. Credentials without a reviewed adapter return Unsupported without an exploratory network request.
quota.notRequestedBody: No credential quota request runs when this page opens. Start a bounded read when you need current capacity.
quota.capacityBody: Each isolated account reports an independent typed capability and provider-specific windows.
quota.noneBody: No stored credential metadata is available.
quota.unsupportedBody: Pi Router made no quota request for this credential.
quota.errorBody: The bounded provider quota read failed without returning a raw response.

logs.title: Logs Viewer
logs.description: Incremental polling over the bounded, sanitized process event buffer.
logs.cleared: The current browser log view was cleared.
logs.clearHelp: Clears only events currently shown in this browser.
logs.searchPlaceholder: Filter class, model, provider, status, or code
logs.boundaryRetained: Retained: timestamp, request class, status, duration, model/provider identity, and bounded error code.
logs.boundaryExcluded: Excluded: headers, prompts, bodies, credentials, environment values, upstream responses, and paths.
logs.emptyBody: New API and console activity appears here for the lifetime of this process.
logs.noMatchBody: Clear the search or choose a broader result filter.
logs.fileActionsUnavailable: Pi Router does not expose file-log clear/download endpoints. These controls remain unavailable until a typed backend capability is accepted.

config.title: Config Panel
config.description: Edit the router-owned raw config.yaml without losing comments or formatting.
config.rawBody: This source may contain management keys, provider keys, headers, environment values, listener settings, and logging policy.
config.unsupportedBody: The server has no router-owned configuration target.
config.notEditable: The current configuration is outside the Management API allowlist. Repair it through the local CLI before using this panel.
config.sourceDescription: CodeMirror provides YAML highlighting, search, line numbers, and browser-side diagnostics.
config.rawRecovery: The server retains the immediately previous raw source for local recovery.
config.diffDescription: Confirm the YAML change and backend field validation before Apply.
config.noPreviewBody: Edit the YAML, then validate to see the source and bounded backend diff.
config.invalid: The draft was not accepted. No file was written.
config.noChangesBody: The validated draft is semantically identical to the current configuration.
config.validRaw: Browser YAML syntax validation passed. Server semantic validation runs atomically on Apply.
config.yamlError: YAML syntax error at line {{line}}, column {{column}}: {{message}}
config.yamlMappingError: Configuration must be a YAML mapping.
config.appliedRestart: Configuration applied. Restart Pi Router to activate every change.
config.restoredRestart: Recovery configuration restored; restart is required.
config.applyBody: Replace config.yaml with these exact source bytes after server validation?
config.lockoutBody: Listener, port, remote-management access, or the management secret changed. The current console may disconnect and a restart may be required.
config.restoreBody: Replace the current document with the retained validated predecessor?

system.title: System
system.description: Version posture, documentation, model discovery, and local browser data.
system.upToDate: Pi Router is up to date.
system.requestLoggingBody: The raw config request-logging field controls the sanitized in-memory event buffer; bodies, headers, and secrets remain excluded.
system.modelsBody: Enter one proxy API key to query /v1/models. This key stays in page memory and is never persisted.
system.proxyKeyPlaceholder: Enter a current proxy API key
system.modelsEmpty: No models are available to this proxy key.
system.localDataBody: Remove the optional obfuscated management-bearer envelope from this browser. The current page stays connected until you disconnect.
system.clearBody: Remove only Pi Router's remembered management-bearer envelope from local storage?
